detect.public_version_note: the string after CX_VERSION's value in distversion.pyc; also names CodeWeavers' sources tarball (crossover-sources-<public_version>.tar.gz)

sources.url_note: CrossOver Preview sources; https://media.codeweavers.com/pub/crossover/source/crossover-sources-20261015.tar.gz was 404 on 2026-10-30, so the tarball came from CodeWeavers outside that directory. Only needed to regenerate or check patches/dxvk/cxaddon-1.10.3/0001 and the DXMT base commit, never by CI.

stock.commit_note: 8f06be3 is in neither 3Shain/dxmt (all branches and PRs) nor GitHub's commit search. CodeWeavers' sources tarball for this build holds DXMT at exactly fb451568 (v0.80-247), differing only in .gitmodules URLs and -marm64x in build-arm64ec.txt; the shipped binaries carry none of upstream's post-fb451568 string changes (e.g. 186a2327, a22700c7), so 8f06be3 is fb451568 plus CodeWeavers-internal commits. fb451568 is the published source for this build and what we build.

wine_unix.note: winemetal.so links @rpath/ntdll.so and @rpath/winemac.so (resolved from lib/wine/<arch>-unix of the runner) and binds _NtSetEvent from ntdll.so; everything from winemac.so is looked up at run time, first CrossOver's struct macdrv_functions, then the plain macdrv symbols. The PE side talks to winemetal.so over Wine's __wine_unix_call.

dxvk.patches_origin: 0001 is sources/dxvk of the sources tarball diffed against upstream v1.10.3, without CodeWeavers' cxlab/ CI files

stock.commit_note: f35d839 is in no branch, tag or PR of 3Shain/dxmt, and the 26.3 sources tarball holds no DXMT (sources/ has dxvk, moltenvk, vkd3d, wine, ... but no dxmt, nested archives included). The shipped binaries are a v0.72 maintenance branch: they have upstream's later nvapi stubs (a60483b7, cffcdb47, f18b1c42: NvAPI_GPU_GetArchInfo, GetBusType, GetMemoryInfoEx) but not DXMT_SHADER_CACHE (44c6fc57, 9 commits after v0.72 on main), so v0.72 plus cherry-picks. We build the public v0.72 tag.

dxmt.patches_origin: 0001 and 0002 are upstream e67727f2 and 06065754, build fixes for current toolchains (libc++ without transitive <functional>/<iterator>, Xcode 27's Metal atomics); 0003 is ours

wine_unix.note: As for 27.0.0.41073. CX 26.3's winemac.drv (sources/wine/dlls/winemac.drv/d3dmetal.c) exports struct macdrv_functions_t, and its d3dmetal_macdrv_win_data starts hwnd, cocoa_window, cocoa_view, client_cocoa_view: the prefix v0.72's winemetal_unix.c reads.

dxvk.note: not built: a Rosetta-only runner loads CrossOver's stock x86_64/i386 DXVK
